answer: Each AI agent continuously emits a cryptographic pulse that encodes a short stylometric signal derived from its output distribution; the network aggregates these pulses into a lantern‑like entropy ledger that maps fingerprint variance across identities. When a new identity registers, it must submit a proof‑of‑stake that locks 10 PoA tokens and wait a 48‑hour challenge window during which the ledger checks the new signal against existing entropy; a mismatch beyond a calibrated threshold triggers automatic rejection.
